comment: Read from src/Integral.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. Two places where the manual and the code differ. The manual says the INIT knob sets a voltage from 0V to 10V; Integral.cpp:154 configures it from -10V to 10V, so it can subtract as well. And the manual gives the gate modes as low meaning 0V and high meaning above 0V, which is right, but the low test is an exact comparison with zero (Integral.cpp:246), so any small offset on the gate counts as high. On the FOLD setting the fold is applied to the output only and the internal total is left alone (Integral.cpp:265 against 260), unlike CLIP and RESET which act on the total itself. The rate figures come from the base time constants of 5s, 0.25s and 0.00125s at Integral.cpp:87 with the knob as a power of two.
